KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p181#3/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p181#3/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p181#3/r6.claim: The heedless are those who neglect remembering God and occupy themselves with distractions.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v2p181#3/r6.anchor: من الذين يغفلون عن ذكر الله ويلهون عنه

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r1.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r1.claim: Remembering God inwardly means silently reciting behind the imam during prayer.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r1.anchor: ذكر القرءاة في الصلاة خلف الإمام سرا في نفسه قاله قتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r2.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r2.claim: It can mean remembrance in the heart, sustained reflection so one does not forget God’s favors that require obedience.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r2.anchor: ذكر بالقلب باستدامة الفكر حتى لا ينسى نعم الله الموجبة لطاعته

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r3.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r3.claim: It can mean remembrance on the tongue, either asking God in hope or magnifying Him through recitation.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r3.anchor: ذكره باللسان إما رغبة إليه في دعائه أو تعظيما له بالآية

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r4.speaker: ابن زيد
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r4.claim: The addressee is someone listening to the Qur’an, whether in prayer or during a sermon.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r4.anchor: المستمع للقرآن إما في الصلاة أو الخطبة , قاله ابن زيد

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r5.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r5.claim: Alternatively, the Prophet is addressed, with the instruction applying generally to all morally responsible people.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r5.anchor: أنه خطاب للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ومعناه عام في جميع المكلفين

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r6.claim: Tadarruʿ means humility and reverence; khīfa means fear of God.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r6.anchor: التضرع فهو التواضع والخشوع , وأما الخيفة فمعناه مخافة منه

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r7.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r7.claim: The phrase means speaking quietly, whether remembrance is inward or on the tongue, according to the two readings above.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r7.anchor: يعني أسر القول إما بالقلب أو باللسان على ما تقدم من التأويلين

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r8.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r8.claim: One explanation takes these times as morning and evening.

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r9.speaker: مجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r9.claim: Al-ghuduww is the end of dawn at the morning prayer and al-āsāl the late afternoon at ʿAṣr; Qatāda gives a similar view.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r9.anchor: آخر الفجر صلاة الصبح , والآصال آخر العشي صلاة العصر , قاله مجاهد , ونحوه عن قتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r10.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r10.claim: Not being heedless can mean not neglecting remembrance of God.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r10.anchor: يحتمل وجهين : أحدهما : عن الذكر . والثاني : عن طاعته

MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r11.speaker: الجمهور
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r11.claim: Alternatively, it means not neglecting obedience to all of God’s commands and prohibitions.
MAWARDI-FULL:v2p290#2/r11.anchor: عن طاعته في كل أوامره ونواهيه , قاله الجمهور

MUQATIL:7:205-206/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r1.claim: Remembering God means reciting in prayer with humility and fear of His punishment, quietly rather than aloud.
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r1.anchor: يعنى بالذكر القراءة فى الصلاة، { فى نفسك تضرعا } مستكينا، { وخيفة } ، يعنى وخوفا من عذابه

MUQATIL:7:205-206/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r2.claim: The morning and evening refer to dawn and afternoon; the warning against heedlessness means not neglecting recitation in prayer.
MUQATIL:7:205-206/r2.anchor: { بالغدو والآصال } ، يعنى بالغداة والعشى، { ولا تكن من الغافلين } [آية: 205] عن القراءة فى الصلاة

RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r1.claim: Verbal remembrance first leaves an effect in the imagination, then brings increasing illumination to the spirit; those illuminations return through tongue, imagination, and intellect, each stage reinforcing the others, so the knowers’ journey has no end.
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r1.anchor: ثم يصعد من ذلك الأثر الخيالي مزيد أنوار وجلايا إلى جوهر الروح

RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r2.claim: Although the address to remember God inwardly appears directed to the Prophet, it applies to every accountable person, each according to the station suited to the capacity of the rational soul.
RAZI-FULL:v15p89/r2.anchor: إلا أنه عام في حق كل المكلفين ولكل أحد درجة مخصوصة
